name: MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash
description: MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash is a text-to-speech model built for fast, low-latency generation. It produces high- fidelity, natural, and expressive speech across 23 languages and supports gated instant voice cloning, all while being optimized for real-time responsiveness. Its human-like intonation, rhythm, and emotional nuance make it ideal for voice agents, assistants, and other interactive scenarios where latency and cost are critical.
